title: 1876. Smart Customer Purchase Tracker
description:

30
Easy
Topics
Smart Customer Purchase Tracker
Problem Statement:
A retail store “MegaMart Elite” wants to track how many times each customer makes a purchase in a day.
Each transaction contains a customer_id.
The system must:
1. Count total purchases per customer
2. Identify the customer with the highest purchases
3. If multiple customers have same highest count → print smallest customer_id
Input Format
N
Next N lines:
customer_id
Output Format
customer_id purchase_count
(Sorted by highest purchase count)
Sample Input
5
10
20
10
30
10
Sample Output
10 3
